def format_currency(n):
    if n < 0:
        sign = "-"
        abs_n = -n
    else:
        sign = ""
        abs_n = n
    
    # Convert to string and add commas
    s = str(abs_n)
    # Split into groups of three from the right
    groups = []
    while len(s) > 3:
        groups.insert(0, s[-3:])
        s = s[:-3]
    groups.insert(0, s)
    formatted = ",".join(groups)
    
    return sign + "$" + formatted
```
